title: Algebra categories are invariant under color-equivalent weak approximation
statement:
Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Let $f:M\to O$ be an inert-preserving map from a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad to a small ordinary nonsymmetric infinity operad. Suppose $f$ is a weak approximation in the sense of [def-coef-operadic-weak-approximation] and $f_{[1]}:M_{[1]}\to O_{[1]}$ is an equivalence of infinity categories. Then for every ordinary nonsymmetric infinity operad $P$, restriction induces an equivalence of infinity categories
$$f^*:\operatorname{Alg}_O(P)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Alg}_M(P).$$
Here $\operatorname{Alg}_Q(P)$ is the full subcategory of the functor infinity category over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ on inert-preserving functors $Q\to P$, with all coherent transformations. No space hypothesis on the color category of $O$ is required; the zero-fiber convention of the cited generalized-operad definition remains in force.
